<div class="contact-container">

## Let's Connect

<p>
I'd be happy to connect and discuss opportunities, analytics, marketing, or potential collaborations.
</p>

<div class="contact-links">

<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/zechariahschweitzer/" target="_blank">
<img src="./images/linkedin.png" alt="LinkedIn">
</a>

<a href="https://github.com/zechnschweitzer" target="_blank">
<img src="./images/github.png" alt="GitHub">
</a>

</div>

<form
  class="contact-form"
  action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID"
  method="POST"
>

<div class="form-group">
<label for="name">Name</label>
<input
  type="text"
  id="name"
  name="name"
  placeholder="Your name"
  required
>
</div>

<div class="form-group">
<label for="email">Email</label>
<input
  type="email"
  id="email"
  name="email"
  placeholder="you@example.com"
  required
>
</div>

<div class="form-group">
<label for="message">Message</label>
<textarea
  id="message"
  name="message"
  placeholder="Write your message..."
  required
></textarea>
</div>

<button type="submit" class="submit-button">
Send Message
</button>

</form>

</div>
